name: AIReg-Bench-combined
description: AIReg-Bench-combined is a text-focused benchmark aggregating tasks that evaluate model behavior against regulatory, policy and safety-oriented prompts. It measures compliance, refusal correctness, and classification of potentially disallowed or sensitive content across diverse prompt types. The suite is intended to stress-test model alignment with policy rules and to compare mitigation strategies.
reputation: Niche, research-oriented benchmark with limited but growing use among safety and alignment practitioners.
